messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — PD#INC-4982: 'prometheus: scrape failures > 5m for metrics-exporter-prod'

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty event: triggered (INC-4982). Affected service: metrics-pipeline. Escalation policy: SRE-oncall -> SRE-Lead.

maya: seeing lots of scrape errors in grafana. exporter in us-west-2 shows 503s and timeouts.

simon: confirmed. prometheus logs show `dial tcp ...: connection refused` to exporter host pool-3.

priya: paging current oncall (maya) — maya any chance this is a config push?

maya: not from me. I didn't touch exporters. I can try to hit one instance: `curl -v http://10.3.45.112:9100/metrics` -> connection reset.

dan: received PD page and acked. (ack by dan)

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledged by dan. Next escalation paused.

maya: checking ELB and instance health. ELB shows 502/504 spikes starting ~10:12Z.

lucy: looks like a rollout to the exporter ASG completed ~10:08Z per deploy bot. Could be a bad AMI or bootstrap change.

maya: good catch. listing deploys: `deploy-bot: release/exporter v3.4.7 -> deployed to us-west-2, rolling 10:05-10:09Z`

priya: can we rollback that deploy to stop customer impact? What's impact? Any customer-facing services?

simon: metric scraping failing causes downstream alerting and dashboards to show stale metrics. No direct API outage but control plane monitoring blind spots. Some customers might see degraded alerting.

maya: estimate customer impact: medium — internal SLO observability degraded, some customers with alerting routed through webhook may miss notifications for ~10-15m.

dan: mitigation plan: 1) pause scrape to avoid retries (set `scrape_interval` temporary) 2) roll exporter ASG back to previous AMI 3) disable `prometheus-alerts` that are noisy to avoid cascading pages

lucy: I'll start rollback of ASG to v3.4.6. Kicking off now. (actioned)

incident-bot: Incident declared: metrics-scrape-failure-2026-03-14. Incident commander: maya. Severity: P2.

maya: IC here. assigning roles: scribe=lucy, comms=priya, infra=dan.

priya: posting status to #status-page: "Investigating Prometheus scrape failures for metrics-exporter in us-west-2. Currently rolling back recent exporter deployment. No customer API impact detected; monitoring and alerting may be degraded."

dan: rollback in progress — ASG old-launch-template applied. Terminating bad instances via `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity` and letting new ones come up.

maya: while rollback happens, reduce Prometheus scrape concurrency to minimize cascade: edit prometheus config, set `scrape_timeout: 5s` and `scrape_interval: 30s` for exporter job. Pushing change to staging then prod.

simon: added a temporary `alertmanager` suppress rule for this alert group to avoid more PD pages: `inhibit_rules` applied for 30m.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: escalation suppressed for alert group INC-4982 by simon.

maya: new instances are healthy per ELB checks at 10:23Z. Hitting /metrics returns 200 and payload looks normal.

lucy: rollback completed across ASG by 10:26Z. Monitoring shows scrape success rate recovering.

dan: validating: prom scrape success % back to 99% across us-west-2 by 10:29Z.

priya: updating status page: "Remediated: rollback of exporter rollout completed, metrics scrapes recovered. Follow-up: root cause analysis underway."

maya: will start RCA doc. initial hypothesis: bad AMI or bootstrap screwing up exporter listener, causing 503s. Need to compare userdata and AMI diff.

simon: reopening alert to verify stability for 30m before closing PD incident.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-4982: status changed to "resolved" at 10:33Z by dan (pagerduty).

maya: leaving notes: actions taken, timestamps, rollback commands used: 
```
# rollback quick steps
aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name exporter-asg-us-west-2 --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcd,Version=23
# terminate bad instances
aws ec2 terminate-instances --instance-ids i-0a1b2c3d4e5f
```

lucy: follow-ups: 1) add pre-deploy healthcheck gate for exporter that verifies /metrics returns 200 before marking instance healthy; 2) add canary windows to rollout; 3) add a check in deploy pipeline that compares AMI userdata diffs.

priya: coordinating on-call handoff: dan is on-call for next 2h; I'll do a quick summary for the next oncall: "Saw scrape failures after exporter rollout v3.4.7; rolled back to v3.4.6; scrapes recovered; RCA pending."

dan: ack. I'll monitor for 1h and then hand to next oncall.

maya: scribe, please paste logs and timeline into the incident doc. tag postmortem owner.

lucy: pasted logs and timeline to /docs/incidents/INC-4982.md (link). CC @eng-sre.

maya: closing the slack incident thread. if anything flares up, reopen or create new PD. thanks all. :thumbsup:

(priya reacts :eyes:)
